title: Add tests to `hooks.rs` (orchestrator path)
objective: hooks.rs (Hook trait, HookRegistry, JunieHook) is security-critical orchestrator infra with ZERO test coverage. Add: pre_execute triggers, post_execute result transformation, hook ordering.
acceptance_criteria: hooks.rs has tests for pre/post execute and ordering
policy_note: Owner directive 2026-06-13: NO DOWNGRADES. A module that looks like dead code / an old feature is an INCOMPLETE feature to be completed — never removed or gated out. Upgrade only.
resolution: Added 8 tests to prompt-hub/src/hooks.rs (#[cfg(test)] mod tests) covering the orchestrator path with NO source downgrade: JunieHook stable name; JunieHook pre/post_execute succeed; empty HookRegistry is a no-op; pre_execute and post_execute run all hooks in registration order (verified via a RecordingHook with an Arc<Mutex<Vec<String>>> call log); pre_execute and post_execute short-circuit on the first hook error and propagate it (HubError::Internal); HookRegistry Debug reports hook count. The private async trigger_pre_execute/trigger_post_execute are exercised from inside the module. Gates green under canonical --all-features: cargo test -p prompt-hub hooks => 8 passed; clippy --all-features --all-targets -D warnings clean; default-features library build (cargo build -p prompt-hub, the CI default-build gate) green; cargo fmt --check clean. Done via worktree loop/phtask-0038-hooks-tests.
